description: This circular walk explores the countryside surrounding the Wiltshire villages of Little Somerford and Lea. The route runs for 5.6 miles, following a series of public footpaths and country lanes through the area's pleasant farmland. Along the way you'll also enjoy some fine views of the River Avon, Angrove Wood and the nearby Cotswold Hills. After your walk you could enjoy some refreshments at the Someford Inn in Little Somerford. The family pubs serves good food and has a nice garden area to relax in. They are dog friendly and you can find them at postcode SN15 5JP. To continue your walking head to nearby Malmesbury where you can pick up the Malmesbury Abbey and River Walk .
